posts.text: I think the difference is largely explained by product mix and project complexity. Vivid has consciously moved away from conventional commercial/residential panels towards mission-critical data-centre, metro and industrial applications. Its offering also includes specialised PDUs and SITC projects, where technical qualification, testing and service requirements can create better economics. Management said approximately half of Vivid’s 98 Cr data-centre order book was PDU-related. These are specialised, data-centre-specific products that Vivid developed and recently type-tested.
